notes.title: An update about updates
notes.notes:
20230217
One of a kind gamers! So, we know it doesn’t look like it from the lack of written updates but NRG has been updated pretty much every day since we released it a little over a week ago! Not everything has been a massive change but there’s been a mix of quality of life tweaks and gameplay adjustments like the incredibly controversial relocation of canisters to drop onto platforms most of the time instead of randomly. We had someone suggest making movement quicker so the most recent update raised agility. Thank you all so much for your feedback to help us make this game as good as it can be, keep it up! Expect many more refinements and a few more additions over the coming weeks.

Completed

 Tons of bug fixes and gameplay refinement
 Own shots don’t break finishers anymore
 Canisters fall onto platforms most of the time instead of random distribution
 Shots don’t roll as much on the ground, reducing ground snipes
 Eyewear: 3D, Bottrekkies
 Shot drag removed, gravity increased (need to arc shots more now)
 Co-op leaderboards now reflect individual scores, not combined
 Zombots numbers tweaked, but they always are
 Energy level and shot charge UI
 Agility raised for quicker movement


Next

 Refine energy level and shot charge UI
 Distribute canisters more evenly to reduce clumps
 KO ticker to see who KOs who
 Zombots co-op revivals transfers 15% of points instead of current flat 100
 Music fading and skip song option
 Custom jetpack and slide animation options


Thanks!
-Mac

notes.title: That’s a-spicy update
notes.notes:
20220626
One of a kind gamers! Wow, that’s quite a list in the completed section, isn’t it? That’s the beauty of not having to implement a new major element! We had the opportunity to go through and touch up on a lot of things that were overdue. We’re still narrowing in on a good ranked match structure but we feel like we’re getting a lot closer! The podium is a little more exciting and menu bots can now hover and slide, which should make it look less repetitive. Most of what we’ve got in the “Next” section should get knocked out next week too, so expect another big one! Most of it will be just increased functionality and not much fluff but welcomed changes nonetheless. Let us know what you think of the tweaks!

Completed

 Ranked play ranks more ranky
 Podium streamers and smoke
 Beach sfx and ambient updated, sand poofs
 Menu autobots now hover and slide
 Edge of screen color flash when low energy


Next

 Customize: Capris, 3D, 4.0, Botrekkies
 Player listing redesign
 TAB in-game player breakdown
 Online sub-menu restructuring
 Chips earned and item unlock earned spiffing
 Pause screen settings availability


Thanks!
-Mac

notes.title: Big changes! Hopefully for the best!
notes.notes:
20211024
What’s good, gamers? So last Friday we did an update with a lot of the things marked “Completed” below, but there were a couple bugs that required reverting back to the previous build. Then why are those things still marked as completed? Because we’re confident it’ll be patched up and put back in Monday or Tuesday, latest! The new stage is sliding nirvana and the new platforms only make it better! The whole stage got a little bigger to put a little more room between people when there are 5 or 6 players at once. 2 and 3 player matches might feel a little more empty now but hopefully all in all it was a better call! We sped up player movement and sprint a touch as well as low-charge shots because it all felt a little slow with the bigger stage. Jumps are also loftier so you can reach the new higher platforms so it’s going to be interesting to hear how you feel about all the changes because it’s a pretty big overhaul! Let us know! Also… Psst… A huge scoreboard update is coming… You’re going to like it...

Completed

 Finisher: Close your eyes
 Outfit: Boots
 Finisher camera fix so you don’t stare at the back of stuff sometimes
 Stage platform additions of a proper “mound” and a longer diagonal
 Ring size increase, making all platforms a little farther apart from one another
 Stage layout changed
 Tons of movement tweaks
 Camera pizzaz like shaking when shot, bouncing when falling, etc...


Next

 Finisher: Snuggler, Safe
 Outfit: Fuggs, Visor
 Scoreboard animation to include a lot more information
 Screen pizzaz like the edges turning the color of a player who shot you and pulsing your color when low Energy
 Queuing in the background so you can still use the rest of the menu
 Single player score attack mode


Thanks!
-Mac
